channel.title: GitHub trends
channel.description: Automatically compiled list of trending GitHub repositories

item.title: Rion-Wu-tech/wechat-intelligence-hub
item.description: Local-first WeChat intelligence system with a read-only CLI, Codex skills, searchable chat history, daily briefings, follow-ups and opportunity tracking.

item.title: debpalash/VoiceStudio
item.description: VoiceStudio is the open-source, fully-local ElevenLabs alternative — voice cloning, voice design, video dubbing, dictation, transcription & audiobook creation in 646 languages.

item.title: bilawalsidhu/gods-eye-view
item.description: A spy satellite simulator in your browser, except the data is real. Live open source spatial intelligence on a photorealistic 3D globe.

item.title: arcboxlabs/arcbox
item.description: Run AI agents on real and isolated machines — own kernel, filesystem, and network — with <100ms boot. Local first, OCI compatible, pure Rust.

item.title: tt-a1i/archify
item.description: Agent skill for beautiful, verifiable architecture, workflow, sequence, data-flow, and lifecycle diagrams—self-contained HTML with motion and crisp export.

item.title: lnkiai/m3e-canvas
item.description: Sketch Material 3 Expressive screens in the browser and turn them into vibe-coding prompts.

item.title: rakanki911/DLSS5-Swapper
item.description: DLSS 5 Swapper is a powerful, easy-to-use tool for installing, managing, and restoring DLSS 5 across games and supported emulators. It features automatic game detection, optional drive scanning, DLSS5-Feeder for compatible titles without native DLSS, emulator support, and compatibility with DirectX 9/10/11/12, Vulkan, and OpenGL.

item.title: ayghri/i-have-adhd
item.description: A skill to stop your coding agent from burying the answer. ADHD-friendly output.

item.title: openJiuwen-ai/jiuwenswarm
item.description: JiuwenSwarm is an intelligent AI Agent built on openJiuwen. It extends the powerful capabilities of large language models directly to your fingertips through various communication apps you use daily.

item.title: experientiallabs/experiential
item.description: Experiential is the open source, zero markup gateway for BYOK, self-hosted and 1000+ marketplace models. It learns from your traffic to cut costs, recommend better models, and train a specialized model you own.

item.title: vorssaint/vorssaint-utils
item.description: Free and open-source macOS menu bar toolkit.

item.title: tigerless-labs/autoharness
item.description: Autoharness — a self-learning skill layer for Claude Code — distills skills from your real sessions, updates them as you work, and prunes the ones that stop getting used. No daemon, no benchmark.

item.title: affaan-m/ECC
item.description: The agent harness performance optimization system. Skills, instincts, memory, security, and research-first development for Claude Code, Codex, Opencode, Cursor and beyond.

item.title: cathrynlavery/diagram-design
item.description: 38 editorial diagram types for Claude Code, Codex, and Pi. Self-contained HTML + SVG. No shadows. No Mermaid slop.

item.title: stablyai/orca
item.description: Orca is the ADE for working with a fleet of parallel agents. Run any coding agent with your own subscription. Available on desktop, mobile and remote runtime.

item.title: EvoMap/AutoResearch
item.description: AI/ML research agents from idea to paper-ready evidence. An EvoMap open-source project.
